newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AEI in Dutch Muller group takeover. [CORRECTED 09:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: AEI in Dutch Muller group takeover. [CORRECTED 09:25 GMT]

text.p: Nasdaq-listed Air Express International (AEI) said on Wednesday an agreement had been reached with Dutch Muller Air Freight Holding B.V. to take over parts of its business.

The acquisition will include Muller Air Freight B.V. and its subsidiaries Muller Express Freight B.V. and Concord Express B.V., Muller Sea Freight B.V., Muller Logistics B.V. and Muller Enterprise B.V. as well as its 50 percent stake in Muller Fashion Services B.V.
No financial details of the deal were given.
The two companies will operate separately in the Netherlands until Muller's contracts with foreign agencies end.
The new combination will be the biggest airfreight company in the Netherlands.
The Muller group, founded in 1947, had a net turnover of some 60 million guilders in 1995 and employs 140 (corrects from 260) people in 8 Dutch offices.

AEI, with its head-office in Darien, Connecticut, had a worldwide turnover of $1.2 billion in 1995, of which 85 million guilders came from the Netherlands. AEI employs 260 people in the Netherlands in 9 offices.
